name: bol_com-mcp
description: bol.com (ecommerce channels): me, update_listing, set_inventory, end_listing, list_orders, mark_ship

platform_mcp_bol_com_client_id.title: PLATFORM_MCP_BOL_COM_CLIENT_ID
platform_mcp_bol_com_client_id.description: Client ID of Retailer API credentials created in the bol Seller Dashboard (Settings > API settings); exchanged at POST https://login.bol.com/token (grant_type=client_credentials, HTTP Basic) for a short-lived (~5 minute) JWT.

platform_mcp_bol_com_client_secret.title: PLATFORM_MCP_BOL_COM_CLIENT_SECRET
platform_mcp_bol_com_client_secret.description: The matching client secret. The token is cached until expiry (bol blocks clients that request a token for every call).

tools.name: me
tools.description: No account endpoint without the retailer id; the probe obtains a token and reads page 1 of open orders ({orders[]}) to verify the credentials.

tools.name: update_listing
tools.description: PUT /retailer/offers/{offer-id}/price {pricing: {bundlePrices: [{quantity: 1, unitPrice}]}} replaces the LIVE price of the offer with a single unit price (EUR, any volume/bundle prices are removed). `price` is required; stock is set_inventory; the product title is catalogue data. Returns a process status (status PENDING at first).

tools.name: set_inventory
tools.description: PUT /retailer/offers/{offer-id}/stock {amount, managedByRetailer: false} sets the stock of one offer (listing_id = bol offer id, required; offers are not addressed by SKU here). managedByRetailer false means bol deducts sold items from the amount. Asynchronous process status.

tools.name: end_listing
tools.description: DELETE /retailer/offers/{offer-id} deletes the offer (not reversible; a new offer must be created). To pause it instead, set stock 0. Asynchronous process status.

tools.name: list_orders
tools.description: GET /retailer/orders?page(50 per page)&status(OPEN|SHIPPED|ALL, default OPEN)&latest-change-date(YYYY-MM-DD, up to 3 months back) for orders fulfilled by the retailer (FBR). The list carries no amounts; `status` is the first order item's fulfilmentStatus (OPEN|HANDLED). raw.orderItems[].orderItemId is what mark_shipped needs.

tools.name: mark_shipped
tools.description: POST /retailer/shipments {orderItems: [{orderItemId}], transport: {transporterCode, trackAndTrace}} ships ONE ORDER ITEM with your own transporter: `order_id` must be the orderItemId (raw.orderItems[].orderItemId of list_orders), called once per item. `carrier` is a bol transporterCode from the transporters list in the Retailer API docs (e.g. TNT for PostNL, DHL, DPD-NL). Asynchronous process status.
